item.description: URL parsing inconsistencies across plugins causing test failures at call stage. Many plugins fail due to improper URL parsing in the base plugin class, particularly with handling of URL components like user, password, host, port, and path.
item.contract: Ensure all plugins inherit consistent URL parsing behavior from NotifyBase class. The base class must properly parse and validate URL components (user, password, host, port, path) before plugin-specific processing occurs. This includes proper handling of URL schemes, authentication credentials, and path components.

item.description: Template configuration issues causing "None found but not defined in the template configuration" errors. The template configuration validation logic is inconsistent and fails to properly validate required template entries.
item.contract: Implement standardized template configuration validation that ensures all required tokens and arguments are properly defined and validated. The validation must check that all template tokens referenced in templates are properly defined in the template_tokens dictionary and that all arguments referenced in the template arguments are properly defined in the template_args dictionary.

item.description: Plugin initialization and enable/disable state handling inconsistencies. Some plugins fail due to incorrect enable/disable state handling or missing initialization logic in the base plugin class.
item.contract: Ensure consistent plugin initialization and enable/disable logic. The base class must properly handle plugin enable/disable states during instantiation and ensure that disabled plugins return None when instantiated. The __init__ method should validate the enabled property and handle instantiation accordingly.
